_readme.about: Tradetron strategy export. Edit and re-import via the ASB Import button.
_readme.logic: To change a condition's logic, edit its "conditionJson" (the AST). The "conditionValue"/"conditionDisplay" text is regenerated from it on import.
_readme.legs: For a leg field that has a "*Json" (e.g. "strikeJson"), edit the JSON — its text form is regenerated on import. Fields with no "*Json" (e.g. "qty") are plain text: edit them directly.
_readme.structure: Add/remove/duplicate legs, conditions or sets by editing the arrays.
_readme.do_not: Do not add "*_id" foreign keys back. Lists referenced by id must be ones you own.

name: Nifty 3Min Momentum Strategy
description: Directional momentum option buying strategy on NIFTY 50 index using 3-minute OHLC completed candles. Enters Buy CE when 3-min Close[-1] > Close[-2] + Spot_Confirm (5 pts) and Close[-2] > Close[-3]. Enters Buy PE on bearish breakdown.
